### A Promise for "The Poor in Spirit"
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-promise-for-quot-the-poor-in-spirit-quot
Passage: Matthew 5:3
Points:
- Being poor in spirit does not mean financial poverty, but genuine humility and awareness of spiritual bankruptcy.
- Modern society elevates aggressive pride and self-sufficiency, which only breeds unhappiness and spiritual blindness.
- Christ promises a place in the kingdom of heaven to those who acknowledge they bring nothing of their own to God.
- The fundamental trait of a true servant is continual, childlike dependence on the living Lord.

### The Pure in Heart
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-february-7.html
Passage: Matthew 5:8
Points:
- Purity of heart does not demand flawless sinlessness, but yielding one's intellect, emotions, and will to God.
- Believers are granted positional purity through Christ's righteousness and are guided into practical holiness by the Holy Spirit.
- Walking with an undivided heart allows believers to recognize God at work in daily circumstances and in Scripture.
- The ultimate fulfillment of this promise is the joy of seeing the Lord face to face in eternity.
